title: ‘I Would Like You to Do Us a Favor’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的Dealbook峰会现场采访多位在商业、政治和文化领域极具影响力的领袖，其中包括万斯、

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·莫达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经删减的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上

sentences.en: November 18th.
sentences.zh: 对部分采访进行直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The White House releases a reconstruction of President Trump's phone call to the leader of
sentences.zh: 白宫公布了特朗普总统与

sentences.en: Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰领导人通话记录的重构文本。

sentences.en: In it, Trump says, quote, I would like you to do us a favor.
sentences.zh: 其中，特朗普说，引述一下：“我想请你帮个忙。”

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月26日，星期四。

sentences.en: Mike Schmidt, tell us about this document that was released on Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 迈克·施密特，请给我们讲讲周三上午发布的这份文件。

sentences.en: So, since this story began, we've all been trying to get a transcript of a July call between
sentences.zh: 自从这个故事开始以来，我们大家一直试图获取7月份特朗普与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基通话的文字记录，

sentences.en: Trump and Volodymyr Zelensky, the president of Ukraine, who had just come into office.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基刚刚上任。

sentences.en: And today, we got the closest thing to that, but not exactly that.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们得到了最接近这一记录的东西，但并非完全如此。

sentences.en: It's actually not a transcript.
sentences.zh: 它其实不是逐字记录。

sentences.en: It's based on notes and voice recognition software that was apparently listening in.
sentences.zh: 它是根据当时显然在进行旁听的笔记和语音识别软件整理出来的。

sentences.en: And it does sort of read like a transcript, but the White House says cannot be treated as such.
sentences.zh: 它读起来有点像文字记录，但白宫表示不能当作文字记录来对待。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, it's transcript-like.
sentences.zh: 所以，它类似于文字记录。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I have this feeling that this document, this not quite a transcript, is going to be the subject of enormous debate and scrutiny in the coming weeks and months.
sentences.zh: 我有一种感觉，这份文件——这个不太像文字记录的文件——将在未来几周和几个月内成为引发巨大争论和审视的主题。

sentences.en: So, I think that you and I should just read some of it.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为你和我应该只读其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Not all of it, but a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 不是全部，但要读很大一部分。

sentences.en: I'm going to start at the top and ask that you read Trump, and I will read Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 我从头开始，请你读特朗普的部分，我来读泽连斯基的部分。

sentences.en: Why do you get to choose?
sentences.zh: 凭什么你来选？

sentences.en: MoSt. I'm going to give you a copy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我给你一份副本。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, at the top of the document, it begins, unclassified.
sentences.zh: 那么，在文件的顶部，开头写着：未分类。

sentences.en: And then struck out are the words, eyes only, do not copy.
sentences.zh: 然后被划掉的词是：仅限密阅，切勿复制。

sentences.en: Memorandum of telephone conversation.
sentences.zh: 电话交谈备忘录。

sentences.en: Subject.
sentences.zh: 主题。

sentences.en: Telephone conversation with
sentences.zh: 与乌克兰

sentences.en: President Zelensky of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基总统的电话交谈。

sentences.en: Date, time.
sentences.zh: 日期，时间。

sentences.en: July 25th, 2019.

sentences.zh: 上午9点03分至9点33分。

sentences.en: Eastern Time.
sentences.zh: 美国东部时间。

sentences.en: And then the president begins.
sentences.zh: 然后总统开始发言。

sentences.en: So, go ahead, Mike.
sentences.zh: 那么，请吧，迈克。

sentences.en: Congratulations on a great victory.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你取得伟大的胜利。

sentences.en: We all watched from the United States, and you did a terrific job.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国都观看了，你干得非常出色。

sentences.en: The way you came from behind, somebody who wasn't given much of a chance, and you ended up winning easily.
sentences.zh: 你后来居上，一开始并不被看好，最后却赢得轻轻松松。

sentences.en: It's a fantastic achievement.
sentences.zh: 这是一个了不起的成就。

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你。

sentences.en: You are absolutely right, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 您说的完全对，总统先生。

sentences.en: We did win big, and we worked hard for this.
sentences.zh: 我们确实大获全胜，为此我们付出了努力。

sentences.en: We worked a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们付出了很多努力。

sentences.en: But I would like to confess to you that I had an opportunity to learn from you.
sentences.zh: 但我向您坦白，我有机会向您学习。

sentences.en: We used quite a few of your skills and knowledge, and were able to use it as an example for our elections.
sentences.zh: 我们借鉴了您不少的技巧和知识，并能够将其作为我们选举的榜样。

sentences.en: And yes, it is true that these were unique elections.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些选举确实很独特。

sentences.en: We were in a unique situation that we were able to achieve a unique success.
sentences.zh: 我们处在一个独特的境地，从而取得了独特的成功。

sentences.en: I'm able to tell you the following.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉您以下几点。

sentences.en: The first time, you called me to congratulate me when I won my presidential election.
sentences.zh: 第一次，当我赢得总统选举时，您打电话向我表示祝贺。

sentences.en: And the second time, you are now calling me when my party won the parliamentary election.
sentences.zh: 第二次，现在我的政党赢得了议会选举，您又打电话给我。

sentences.en: I think I should run more often, so you can call me more often, and we can talk over the phone more often.
sentences.zh: 我想我应该更经常地参选，这样您就能更经常地打电话给我，我们就能更经常地通电话了。

sentences.en: The president laughs.
sentences.zh: 总统笑了。

sentences.en: That's a very good idea.
sentences.zh: 这主意真不错。

sentences.en: I think your country is very happy about that.
sentences.zh: 我想你们国家对此非常高兴。

sentences.en: Okay, Mike.
sentences.zh: 好了，迈克。

sentences.en: This is all very complimentary between the two leaders, but especially Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 两位领导人之间的这些客套话真不少，尤其是泽连斯基。

sentences.en: Zelensky's basically speaking Trump's language.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基基本上是在说特朗普的语言。

sentences.en: He goes on to say that he's going to drain the swamp in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他接着说他要在乌克兰清除腐败势力。

sentences.en: He's basically saying, I'm modeling myself after you.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，我正在以你为榜样。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm a mini-Trump.
sentences.zh: 我是个迷你特朗普。

sentences.en: Okay, so where should we go next?
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们接下来该看哪里？

sentences.en: Well, basically at the top, Trump lays out how good he and the United States have been to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，基本上在一开始，特朗普就阐述了他和美国对乌克兰有多好。

sentences.en: Okay, let's read that section.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来读一下那部分。

sentences.en: So Trump says, I will say that we do a lot for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普说，我要说的是，我们为乌克兰做了很多。

sentences.en: We spend a lot of effort and a lot of time, much more than the European countries are doing, and they should be helping you more than they are.
sentences.zh: 我们花了很多精力和时间，比欧洲国家做的要多得多，他们应该比现在更多地帮助你。

sentences.en: Germany does almost nothing for you.
sentences.zh: 德国几乎没为你做过什么。

sentences.en: All they do is talk, and I think it's something that you should really ask them about.
sentences.zh: 他们只会空谈，我认为这是你应该真正质问他们的事情。

sentences.en: When I was speaking to Angela Merkel, she talks Ukraine, but she doesn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 我和安格拉·默克尔交谈时，她总是满口乌克兰，但什么也不做。

sentences.en: A lot of the European countries are the same way, so I think it's something you want to look at, but the United States has been very, very good to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 许多欧洲国家也是如此，所以我想这是你需要关注的事情，但美国对乌克兰一直非常非常好。

sentences.en: I wouldn't say that it's reciprocal necessarily, because things are happening that are not good, but the United States has been very, very good to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我不会说这一定是相互的，因为有些不好的事情正在发生，但美国对乌克兰一直非常非常好。

sentences.en: Yes, you are absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 是的，您完全正确。

sentences.en: Not only 100%, but actually 1000%.
And then Zelensky says,
sentences.zh: 然后泽连斯基说，

sentences.en: I would also like to thank you for your great support in the area of defense.
sentences.zh: 我也想感谢您在国防领域给予的大力支持。

sentences.en: We are ready to continue to cooperate for the next steps.
sentences.zh: 我们准备继续就下一步合作进行合作。

sentences.en: Specifically, we are almost ready to buy more javelins from the United States for defense purposes.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们已经基本准备好从美国购买更多标枪导弹用于国防目的。

sentences.en: Okay, Mike, so what's happening here?
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: So, off the bat, Trump makes a strong argument for how good he and the United States have been to
sentences.zh: 所以，一开场，特朗普就强力论证了他和美国对

sentences.en: Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰有多好。

sentences.en: He lays out how that help is far better than anything they've gotten from the European countries.
sentences.zh: 他阐述了这种援助远比他们从欧洲国家得到的任何东西都要好。

sentences.en: And it looks, on one hand, like he's building an argument towards potentially asking for something.
sentences.zh: 一方面，看起来他是在为可能提出某种要求做铺垫。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it's a common refrain from Trump that we've heard from before he ran for president, that the United States pays too much to other countries and major
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这也是特朗普一贯的陈词滥调，我们在他竞选总统之前就听过：美国向其他国家支付了太多费用，而欧洲国家等主要

sentences.en: world powers like countries in Europe don't pay their fair share.
sentences.zh: 世界强国却没有承担他们应付的份额。

sentences.en: And what is Trump referring to when he says that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说美国对乌克兰

sentences.en: has been so good to Ukraine, so helpful?
sentences.zh: 如此之好、如此有帮助，究竟指的是什么？

sentences.en: That the United States has given hundreds of millions of dollars over the years to help
sentences.zh: 指美国多年来提供数亿美元来帮助

sentences.en: Ukraine protect themselves.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰保护自己。

sentences.en: They have Russia to the east of them.
sentences.zh: 他们的东面是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: They're very afraid of being overrun by them.
sentences.zh: 他们非常害怕被俄罗斯吞并。

sentences.en: And this money has helped them build up their military in self-defense.
sentences.zh: 这些钱帮助他们建立了自己的军事力量以进行自卫。

sentences.en: And what's significant about the fact that the president is bringing this up right away?
sentences.zh: 总统这么快就提起这件事，有什么重大意义？

sentences.en: So Congress had just approved $400 million in aid to go to Ukraine, but Trump had ordered his aides to put a halt on it.
sentences.zh: 国会刚刚批准了4亿美元的对乌克兰援助资金，但特朗普下令其助手暂停发放。

sentences.en: Money that Ukraine, from everything you just said, would probably very much want.
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，这笔钱对乌克兰来说可能非常渴望。

sentences.en: That they say they need to protect themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是保护自己所必需的。

sentences.en: And is President Zelensky aware of that fact when he's on the call?
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基总统在通话时是否知道这个事实？

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: But whether he knew it or not, if you're the leader of a country like that and relying on hundreds of millions of dollars from someone else, it's probably on your mind.
sentences.zh: 但无论他知不知道，如果你是一个这样的国家领导人，并且依赖别人的数亿美元援助，这件事大概率会挂在你心上。

sentences.en: And what do we know about why the president is trying to withhold this U.S.
sentences.zh: 关于总统为什么要扣留这笔美国

sentences.en: aid?
sentences.zh: 援助，我们了解到了什么？

sentences.en: We have learned a lot about this story in the past week.
sentences.zh: 我们在过去的一周里了解了很多关于这个故事的信息。

sentences.en: But one of the huge unanswered questions is why is it that Trump was holding up the money?
sentences.zh: 但最大的未解之谜之一就是，特朗普为什么要扣着这笔钱？

sentences.en: Was it simply that he thought we were giving too much money away and he thought the Europeans should be contributing more?
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为他觉得我们给出的钱太多了，认为欧洲人应该贡献更多？

sentences.en: Or it's what he brings up next on the call?
sentences.zh: 还是因为他在电话里接下来提起的事？

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: What he says is that he would like for Zelensky to do him a favor.
sentences.zh: 他所说的是，他希望泽连斯基帮他一个忙。

sentences.en: But it's actually two favors.
sentences.zh: 但实际上是两个忙。

sentences.en: The first relates to the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 第一个与2016年大选有关。

sentences.en: Let me read it to you.
sentences.zh: 我读给你听。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I would like you to do us a favor, though, because our country has been through a lot and Ukraine knows a lot about it.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想请你帮个忙，因为我们国家经历了很多，乌克兰对此了解很多。

sentences.en: I would like you to find out what happened with this whole situation with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我希望你查明乌克兰这整件事情究竟是怎么回事。

sentences.en: And then the president says, I would like to have the attorney general call you or your people, and I would like you to get to the bottom of it.
sentences.zh: 然后总统说，我希望让总检察长或者你们的人打电话给你，我希望你能把事情查个水落石水。

sentences.en: As you saw yesterday, the whole nonsense ended with a very poor performance by a man named Robert Mueller, an incompetent performance.
sentences.zh: 正如你昨天看到的，整场闹剧以一个名叫罗伯特·米勒的人的糟糕表现、无能表现而告终。

sentences.en: But they say a lot of it started with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但他们说很多事情都是从乌克兰开始的。

sentences.en: Whatever you can do, it's very important that you do it if that's possible.
sentences.zh: 无论你能做什么，如果可能的话，你务必把它做好。

sentences.en: Like, how do you interpret that?
sentences.zh: 你如何解读这段话？

sentences.en: Trump has long believed that the real collusion was between Ukrainians and Democrats who fed bad
sentences.zh: 特朗普长期以来一直认为，真正的暗中勾结发生在乌克兰人与民主党人之间，是他们向联邦调查局提供不良

sentences.en: information to the FBI to get the investigation going that ultimately becomes the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 信息，从而引发了最终演变成米勒调查的调查。

sentences.en: Is there any evidence of that?
sentences.zh: 有任何证据吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: It's an elaborate theory that involves allegations about a company called CrowdStrike
sentences.zh: 这是一个精心编造的理论，涉及关于一家名为“众击”（CrowdStrike）的公司、

sentences.en: and how the DNC was hacked and whether fake documents were created to undermine the legitimacy of
sentences.zh: 民主党全国委员会是如何被黑客攻击的，以及是否有人炮制虚假文件来破坏总统竞选主席

sentences.en: Paul Manafort, the president's campaign chairman.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马纳福特的合法性的指控。

sentences.en: It's a very elaborate plot.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常复杂的阴谋。

sentences.en: But if Trump were ever able to prove it, he would be able to show that the Russia investigation and the allegations about ties
sentences.zh: 但如果特朗普能够证明这一点，他就能证明俄罗斯调查以及关于他的竞选团队与俄罗斯之间存在联系的指控

sentences.en: between his campaign and Russia were built on false information.
sentences.zh: 是建立在虚假信息之上的。

sentences.en: So the first favor here is Trump asking Zelensky for evidence that might confirm this theory he has about the origins of the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的第一个忙是特朗普向泽连斯基索要证据，这些证据可能证实他关于俄罗斯调查起源的理论。

sentences.en: He's trying to show that the entire thing was built on false information drummed up by the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他试图证明整件事情都是建立由民主党人捏造的虚假信息之上的。

sentences.en: And Zelensky responds that he's all about it.
sentences.zh: 而泽连斯基回应说他对此完全赞同。

sentences.en: He says, we are open to a new page of cooperation in relations between the United States and Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们对开启美国与乌克兰关系合作的新篇章持开放态度。

sentences.en: In other words, I will help you.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我会帮你的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then he goes on to say that one of his assistants has been in touch with the president's lawyer, Rudy Giuliani, who's been leading the effort to prove these allegations true.
sentences.zh: 接着他继续说，他的一个助手一直在与总统的律师鲁迪·朱利安尼保持联系，朱利安尼一直带头试图证明这些指控属实。

sentences.en: He says he very much looks forward to having his folks meet with Giuliani, who's going to come over and look into these things.
sentences.zh: 他说他非常期待自己的手下与朱利安尼会面，朱利安尼将过来调查这些事情。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Then Trump asks a second favor.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普提出了第二个请求。

sentences.en: Trump asks Zelensky to investigate allegations about Joe Biden's son.
sentences.zh: 特朗普要求泽连斯基调查关于乔·拜登儿子的指控。

sentences.en: Let's read that section.
sentences.zh: 我们来读一下那段。

sentences.en: The president says, there's a lot of talk about Biden's son, that Biden stopped the prosecution, and a lot of people want to find out about that.
sentences.zh: 总统说，关于拜登的儿子有很多传言，拜登阻止了起诉，很多人都想弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: So whatever you can do with the attorney general would be great.
sentences.zh: 所以你跟总检察长能怎么配合，那就太好了。

sentences.en: Biden went around bragging that he stopped the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 拜登到处吹嘘说他阻止了起诉。

sentences.en: So if you can look into it, it sounds horrible to me.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能调查一下，在我听来这太恶劣了。

sentences.en: Mike, what's happening here?
sentences.zh: 迈克，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: This is a longstanding theory Trump has had that Joe Biden had a prosecutor fired in Ukraine to stop him from looking into allegations about a company his son worked for.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普长期以来的一种理论，他认为乔·拜登在乌克兰撤换了一名检察官，是为了阻止对方调查他儿子曾工作过的一家公司。

sentences.en: And he says,
sentences.zh: 然后他说，

sentences.en: I will have Mr. Giuliani give you a call.
sentences.zh: 我会让朱利安尼先生给你打个电话。

sentences.en: And I'm also going to have Attorney General Bill Barr give you a call to talk about these Biden allegations.
sentences.zh: 我还打算让总检察长威廉·巴尔给你打电话，谈谈这些关于拜登的指控。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Trump says, so whatever you can do with the
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，所以你和

sentences.en: Attorney General would be great.
sentences.zh: 总检察长能怎么配合，那就太好了。

sentences.en: So the president is drawing his personal lawyer,
sentences.zh: 所以总统把他的私人律师

sentences.en: Rudy Giuliani, and the Attorney General for the United States, Bill Barr, into this attempt to have
sentences.zh: 鲁迪·朱利安尼以及美国总检察长威廉·巴尔都牵扯进了这场试图让

sentences.en: Ukraine investigate Joe Biden, his political rival.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰调查乔·拜登（他的政治对手）的行动中。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And hopefully the fruits of that investigation will be passed back to the Justice
sentences.zh: 并且希望那项调查的成果能够转交给司法

sentences.en: Department.
sentences.zh: 部。

sentences.en: For what purpose?
sentences.zh: 为了什么目的？

sentences.en: Well, there's really only one thing the Justice Department does in this area, and that would be a criminal prosecution.
sentences.zh: 嗯，司法部在这个领域实际上只有一件事可做，那就是刑事起诉。

sentences.en: So in addition to asking a foreign government to get involved in the election, it seems he's implying he's asking his Justice Department to do the same.
sentences.zh: 因此，除了要求外国政府介入选举之外，他似乎还在暗示，他也要求自己的司法部这样做。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How can this foreign country help my own Justice Department go after the candidate who may run against him in a year for president?
sentences.zh: 这个外国怎么能帮我自己的司法部去对付可能在一年后跟他竞选总统的候选人呢？

sentences.en: Mike, is it important that there's no explicit offer of something for something else?
sentences.zh: 迈克，里面没有明确的利益交换暗示，这重要吗？

sentences.en: No explicit quid pro quo for these favors that the president is asking for?
sentences.zh: 对于总统要求的这些恩惠，没有明确的利益交换吗？

sentences.en: He didn't say, for example, if you don't do these favors, I won't give you aid.
sentences.zh: 比方说，他没有讲，如果你不帮这些忙，我就不给你援助。

sentences.en: Or he didn't say, by the way, I'm not sure if you know this, but I have withheld some aid and you're only going to get it if you do these favors.
sentences.zh: 或者他没有讲，顺便说一句，我不知道你知不知道，但我扣留了一些援助，只有当你帮了这些忙时你才能拿到。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But in any type of scheme, it's not like someone sits down and writes in a document, here's how we're breaking the law or here's how I'm setting up the quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 但在任何类型的阴谋中，都不会有人坐下来在文件里写道，我们是怎么违法的，或者我是怎么设置利益交换的。

sentences.en: But moments earlier in the call, he had brought up the aid the United States was providing to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但在通话刚开始没多久，他就提到了美国向乌克兰提供的援助。

sentences.en: Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰。

sentences.en: So you could see where one reading of this document would be that the president had built the leverage at the top of the call and then moved in later on to ask for the favor.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出，对这份文件的一种解读是，总统在通话一开始就建立起了筹码，然后稍后才提出寻求帮忙。

sentences.en: So the other side of the favor is just in the air because the president is talking about just how supportive the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以另一半的帮忙是心照不宣的，因为总统一直在谈论美国是多么

sentences.en: is of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 支持乌克兰。

sentences.en: It was one of the major topics they were discussing literally minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们就在几分钟前讨论的主要话题之一。

sentences.en: What's the other reading of this?
sentences.zh: 那对这事的另一种解读是什么？

sentences.en: That the discussions about aid to Ukraine and the favors are unrelated.
sentences.zh: 那就是关于对乌援助的讨论和那些帮忙是毫无关系的。

sentences.en: They just happen to be in the same call.
sentences.zh: 它们只是恰好出现在同一次通话中。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is talking about a lot of different things, bringing up a lot of different topics.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普谈论了许多不同的事情，提出了许多不同的主题。

sentences.en: So let's talk about how this call ends.
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈这次通话是如何结束的。

sentences.en: It sort of ends as it began with flattery.
sentences.zh: 它结束的方式就像开始时一样，充满了奉承。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Zelensky says it might be a very good idea for you to travel to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基说，你来乌克兰访问可能是一个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: We can either take my plane and go to Ukraine or we can take your plane, which is probably much better than mine.
sentences.zh: 我们可以坐我的飞机去乌克兰，或者我们可以坐你的飞机，那可能比我的好得多。

sentences.en: Trump says, OK, we can work that out.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，好的，我们可以安排。

sentences.en: I look forward to seeing you in Washington and maybe in Poland because I think we are going to be there at that time.
sentences.zh: 我期待在华盛顿见到你，也许还有波兰，因为我想我们到时候会在那里。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: Congratulations on a fantastic job you've done.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你取得了不起的成绩。

sentences.en: The whole world was watching.
sentences.zh: 全世界都在看着。

sentences.en: I'm not sure it was so much of an upset, but congratulations.
sentences.zh: 我不敢说这是一场多大的冷门，但还是祝贺你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: Bye bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅时报才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用时报一个月，而且不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用，享受30天的免费访问权。

sentences.en: OK, so what comes of this call?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么这次通话的结果是什么？

sentences.en: Trump tells Zelensky that Attorney General
sentences.zh: 特朗普告诉泽连斯基，总检察长

sentences.en: Barr will call him.
sentences.zh: 巴尔会给他打电话。

sentences.en: Zelensky says he will be all over this investigation and do as much as he can for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基表示他会全力推进这项调查，并为特朗普总统尽其所能。

sentences.en: Does any of that stuff actually come to fruition?
sentences.zh: 那些事情真的有结果吗？

sentences.en: So as the readout of the call was released, Barr puts out a statement saying that he knows nothing of this and that he's had no discussions with the Ukrainians on this subject.
sentences.zh: 随着通话纪要的发布，巴尔发表了一份声明，称他对这些事情一无所知，并且他没有就此主题与乌克兰人进行过任何讨论。

sentences.en: What about Zelensky and what he did?
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基以及他的所作所为呢？

sentences.en: We have no evidence that these investigations have actually been conducted.
sentences.zh: 我们没有证据表明这些调查实际上已经进行了。

sentences.en: So it's possible that what was discussed in this call kind of just fizzled out?
sentences.zh: 所以这次通话中讨论的内容有可能就这样不了了之了？

sentences.en: Maybe, but I think that there's still a lot here that we don't know.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，但我认为这里面还有很多我们不知道的事情。

sentences.en: OK, so, Mike, we're learning about the contents of this call the day after the
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么，迈克，我们是在民主党人

sentences.en: Democrats announced that they would open an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 宣布将开启弹劾调查的第二天得知这次通话内容的。

sentences.en: What does this do to that process?
sentences.zh: 这对那个进程有什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, I certainly think it strengthens it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当然认为它起到了推动作用。

sentences.en: It's a fresh stream of evidence that shows the president trying to get a foreign country to meddle in our election and to help our Justice Department go after his rivals.
sentences.zh: 这是一股新鲜的证据流，显示总统试图让外国政府干预我们的选举，并帮助我们的司法部去对付他的政敌。

sentences.en: And it's pretty clear.
sentences.zh: 而且它非常清晰。

sentences.en: It's this self-contained document.
sentences.zh: 这是一个独立的完整文件。

sentences.en: And it's sort of simple and easy to understand.
sentences.zh: 而且它有点简单易懂。

sentences.en: It's a back and forth between two leaders.
sentences.zh: 这是两位领导人之间的来回对话。

sentences.en: You can see what Trump wants and how he's trying to use his influence on the other side.
sentences.zh: 你能看出特朗普想要什么，以及他是如何试图对另一方施加影响的。

sentences.en: Remember, Trump has been accused of so many different things, many of them incredibly complicated, involving ideas like collusion or
sentences.zh: 记住，特朗普被指控过太多不同的事情，其中许多极其复杂，涉及串通或

sentences.en: obstruction of justice or Russian names that we've never heard of.
sentences.zh: 妨碍司法公正或我们从未听过的俄罗斯人名等概念。

sentences.en: And in this case, it's a simple call.
sentences.zh: 而在这种情况下，这是一通简单的电话。

sentences.en: And I think that that's what makes it so powerful.
sentences.zh: 我认为正是这一点让它如此具有杀伤力。

sentences.en: It feels like a week ago there was a whistleblower complaint and then suddenly reporting on the existence of a phone call.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像一周前才出现了一份吹哨人举报，然后突然就报道出了通话的存在。

sentences.en: And I know that there's a lot about the whistleblower complaint that we don't know.
sentences.zh: 我知道关于吹哨人举报还有很多我们不知道的事。

sentences.en: But if you're the whistleblower, it feels like a fair bit has been accomplished by filing that complaint at this point.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是吹哨人，会觉得通过在此时提交那份举报已经完成相当多的工作了。

sentences.en: And he still hasn't spoken to Congress.
sentences.zh: 而他仍然没有向国会发言。

sentences.en: He still hasn't testified or laid it out for the entire country to see.
sentences.zh: 他仍然没有作证或向整个国家公开陈述。

sentences.en: So it's been pretty powerful in this short period of time.
sentences.zh: 所以在这么短的时间内，这已经相当具有威力了。

sentences.en: I wonder if the reason why this feels so powerful and compelling to so many of these Democrats in a way that the Russia investigation
sentences.zh: 我在想，为什么这让这么多的民主党人感到如此有力且令人信服，而在俄罗斯调查中

sentences.en: did not is because it's the president's own words.
sentences.zh: 却没有这种感觉，是不是因为这是总统自己的原话。

sentences.en: We never had testimony from the president in the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 在穆勒调查中，我们从未获得过总统的证词。

sentences.en: He always declined to do that.
sentences.zh: 他总是拒绝这么做。

sentences.en: And when it came to conversations that were claimed to have been had by James Comey, for example, the president just said, there were two of us in a room.
sentences.zh: 而当谈到据说詹姆斯·科米等人进行的对话时，总统只是说，房间里当时只有我们两个人。

sentences.en: I dispute it.
sentences.zh: 我对此有异议。

sentences.en: It was always secondhand.
sentences.zh: 这总是二手信息。

sentences.en: It was someone like Comey testifying or we were reading his memos.
sentences.zh: 要么是像科米这样的人作证，要么是我们阅读他的备忘录。

sentences.en: In this case, you see the president behind closed doors in his own words.
sentences.zh: 而在这种情况下，你看到的是闭门之下的总统用他自己的原话表达。

sentences.en: And the documents are being released by his White House.
sentences.zh: 而且这些文件是由他的白宫发布的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you can see exactly how he tries to use his office when he's quietly on the phone with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 并且你能清楚地看到当他私下与外国领导人通电话时，他是如何试图运用其权力的。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the White House sent a copy of the whistleblower's complaint to Congress.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，白宫向国会发送了一份吹哨人举报的副本。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the intelligence officer who filed the complaint raised alarms not just about the content of the call between Trump and Zelensky,
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，提交举报的情报官员不仅对特朗普与泽连斯基通话的内容拉响了警报，

sentences.en: but also about how the White House handled records of the conversation.
sentences.zh: 而且还对白宫处理该对话记录的方式提出了质疑。

sentences.en: In the House, support for an impeachment inquiry reached a major milestone, with 218 members supporting the move, a majority of those in the chamber.
sentences.zh: 在众议院，对弹劾调查的支持达到了一个重大里程碑，有218名议员支持此举，占了议会多数。

sentences.en: Of those, 217 are Democrats, one is independent, and zero are
sentences.zh: 在这些人中，217名是民主党人，1名是独立人士，零名是

sentences.en: Republican.
sentences.zh: 共和党人。

sentences.en: In the Senate, where any impeachment would eventually arrive, Republicans appeared deeply divided over the contents of Trump's call with Ukraine's president.
sentences.zh: 在任何弹劾最终都会到达的参议院，共和党人似乎对特朗普与乌克兰总统通话的内容产生了深深的分歧。

sentences.en: I did read the transcript.
sentences.zh: 我确实读了文字记录。

sentences.en: It remains troubling in the extreme.
sentences.zh: 它极其令人不安。

sentences.en: Senator Mitt Romney of Utah expressed disapproval, while Senator Lindsey Graham of South Carolina wrote on Twitter, quote, quote, wow, impeachment over this.
sentences.zh: 犹他州参议员米特·罗姆尼表达了不满，而南卡罗来纳州参议员林赛·格雷厄姆在推特上写道，原话是，哇，居然为这事搞弹劾。

sentences.en: During a news conference, President Trump denied that he had offered anything to Ukraine's president in return for his request to investigate Biden and his son.
sentences.zh: 在一次新闻发布会上，特朗普总统否认他曾向乌克兰总统提供任何东西来换取对拜登及其儿子的调查请求。

sentences.en: You take a look at that call.
sentences.zh: 你们看一看那通电话。

sentences.en: It was perfect.
sentences.zh: 非常完美。

sentences.en: I didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 我没有做那种事。

sentences.en: There was no quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 根本没有什么利益交换。

sentences.en: But in a statement, the heads of the House Democratic committees investigating the president rejected Trump's claim that a quid pro quo was essential to their inquiries.
sentences.zh: 但调查总统的众议院民主党委员会负责人在一份声明中拒绝了特朗普关于利益交换对其调查至关重要的说法。

sentences.en: Let's be clear, the statement read.
sentences.zh: 声明写道，让我们把话说清楚。

sentences.en: No quid pro quo is required to betray our country.
sentences.zh: 出卖国家不需要什么利益交换。

sentences.en: Trump asked a foreign government to interfere in our elections.
sentences.zh: 特朗普要求外国政府干涉我们的选举。

sentences.en: That is betrayal enough.
sentences.zh: 这就已经是足够的背叛了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In Israel, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been chosen to try to form a new government, despite a close election that seemed to represent a defeat for him.
sentences.zh: 在以色列，尽管选举结果对本雅明·内塔尼亚胡来说似乎是一次失败，但他仍被选中尝试组建新政府，尽管选举结果十分胶着。

sentences.en: Israel's president chose Netanyahu, a right-wing leader, over his chief opponent, Benny Gantz, a more moderate figure, after concluding that
sentences.zh: 以色列总统在得出内塔尼亚胡更有可能建立多数派联盟的结论后，选择了右翼领导人内塔尼亚胡，而不是他的主要对手、更加温和的本尼·甘茨。

sentences.en: Netanyahu stood a better chance of creating a majority coalition.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在五个月前的上一次选举后却没有做到这一点。

sentences.en: But Netanyahu failed to do just that five months ago, after the last election.
sentences.zh: 而他目前依然

sentences.en: And he remains for now.
sentences.zh: 距离多数席位差得很远。

sentences.en: Many seats short of a majority.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》就到这里。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎进了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又惊心动魄的争斗中。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带你了解那些试图维持影响力却在途中失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
